request.input:
1girl, solo focus, full body, high angle, looking up, walking up stairs toward the camera, caught mid-step, quiet reserved expression,

Busy railway station entrance. A lower tiled concourse with small commuters recedes behind her.

1.2::three separate parallel routes, a central fixed stone staircase between two side commuter routes::, straight sloping metal dividers separate the routes; slim brass handrails on vertical posts line the INNER sides of the central stairs. Camera on the upper landing looks down the stair flight. Regular stone treads recede toward the concourse. She is centered, entire body inside frame, clear steps below both shoes. One foot planted on a tread, the other knee bends to reach the next higher tread. Right hand at screen-left loosely pinches a train ticket beside her thigh; left hand at screen-right holds her bag strap. Large dark blurred shoulders frame the two foreground corners; sharp woman in the middle distance; smaller softer commuters behind.

Low warm sunlight from the concourse behind her, narrow hair rim light, cool sage face and stair shadows. Long thin railing shadows cross successive treads toward the foreground; shoe contact shadows. Oatmeal beige, dusty blue, muted brass, brown leather; quiet broad wool folds, subtle knit texture.

0.9::quasarcake::, 0.5::rella::, 0.4::gomzi::, 0.3::piromizu::

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
